verdict.rationale: Composio has broad programmatic coverage. A public OpenAPI spec is published, and SDK calls handle sessions, MCP server creation and tool restriction. The CLI can connect apps, execute tools and debug projects, and agents can log in without a browser. However, nothing documents full API–UI parity, and white-label branding is configured 'in the dashboard', which suggests some settings are UI-only. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or API coverage of dashboard-only settings (branding/theme, webhook registration via API), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
